Pirates: Building a Pirate Family.

Chapter 1 Rockefeller Charlotte

chevron_leftPrev Nextchevron_right nights_stay
"Hoo! Hoo!"

"Ten thousand thirty thousand two hundred and twenty one!"

"Ten thousand thirty thousand two hundred and twenty one!"

A sturdy boy of seventeen or eighteen years old by the sea was holding up a dumbbell ten times bigger than himself and waving it.

Every time it is waved, there will be bursts of wind and hunting.

And this boy has been going on for most of the day.

Sweat trickled down his angular muscles to the ground.

With a height of 1.9 meters 15 and strong muscles, it is hard to imagine that this boy is actually only [-] years old.

"Fourteen thousand!"

bump!

When the boy swung to [-], his arm could no longer hold on, and the dumbbell in his hand was thrown to the ground.

"Huh! I'm exhausted!"

The boy sat down on the ground, gasping for breath.

The muscles on both arms trembled slightly.

"Three thousand more swings than yesterday!"

The boy clenched his fists and said excitedly.

You must know that this dumbbell weighs a full hundred tons, but he can easily swing it [-] times.

This is not something ordinary people can do.

That's right, the boy traveled to a world where force is the most important thing.

And this world, the boy is still very familiar with it.

It was the One Piece anime that I saw when I was a child in the last life.

He actually traveled to the world of One Piece.

But he seems to wear early.

Because when he was ten years old, he accidentally saw the Rocks Pirates in the newspaper.

And the current timeline is only 1480 years old.

It will be 40 years before Luffy goes to sea.

Charlotte was completely stunned when he heard the news.

Anyone who has watched One Piece knows that this world is not friendly, and maybe one day it will be invaded by pirates.

Although the number of pirates at this time is far less than that of later generations, but if they are not guaranteed, a group of pirates will come one day.

What made Charlotte even more devastated was that he was in the second half of the great route.

It is also called the new world by later generations.

This made Charlotte even more frightened.

Transmigrating into the body of a ten-year-old boy had already panicked Charlotte, who had just transmigrated, but found out that she was in a new world.

This made Charlotte feel a sense of crisis.

After panicking for a while, Charlotte calmed down.

As a mercenary in his previous life, although he felt that all this was very bizarre, he still resisted himself to accept this reality.

As for why he became a mercenary, this is a bit bizarre.

In my previous life, I heard that going to the Middle East as a mercenary during the summer vacation can make a lot of money, but I don’t know if it’s because of my brain twitch or something. After being introduced by a friend, I joined a group of mercenaries in a daze.

Thus began his mercenary career.

As the saying goes, if you often walk by the river, there is no one who does not get your shoes wet.

During the battle with Xiao Heizi again, a melon grenade appeared beside him at some point.

I don't know who threw it.

It exploded in an instant.

There wasn't even time for Charlotte to react, he just felt his body was torn apart, and he lost consciousness.

After waking up, he traveled to this world, a ten-year-old kid.

And the original owner was unlucky. He was caught in the sea by the waves when he was fishing at the beach, and was slapped hard on the rocks and passed out.

The dove has occupied the magpie's nest.

The island he was on was very small, with a population of just over 1000 people, just a small town.Located in the first half of the new world, there are not many pirates, because not far from here is the G-8 branch of the navy.

Although it is not those branches that later generations are familiar with, it also gives Charlotte, who is only ten years old, a sense of security.

After getting clear about her surroundings, Charlotte began to slowly recall the memory of watching One Piece in her last life.

But this memory surprised Charlotte.

You must know that although he watched One Piece since he was a child, he didn't have much time to watch it as a mercenary. He had almost forgotten the previous plot.

But I didn't expect to be able to remember it clearly now.

This made Charlotte excited.

With these memories, as long as you keep some, it's enough to make it to the finale.

Of course, Charlotte didn't want to hang on.

He also wants to take risks and leave his name in this world.

It's not Charlotte's character to settle for the status quo.

His name in this life is Rockefeller Charlotte.

After knowing that this is the world of One Piece, Charlotte started a planned training.

Charlotte, who has watched One Piece, knows that this world is very dangerous, especially in the age of great navigation, which is even more dangerous. Pirates on the sea are like ants all over the sea.

He didn't want to die in a daze one day.

In order to live a wonderful life for herself, Charlotte started her own training.

He knows One Piece's training system.

Sword art, body art, three-color domineering, devil fruit, spear art.

All can make people stronger.

Charlotte is also seriously considering her next path.

As a mercenary, he was the first to consider spear skills.

But the point is that he doesn't even have a gun!

Moreover, the guns in this world are actually flintlock guns, and Charlotte instantly extinguished this idea.

Consider other ways.

Devil Fruit?

Charlotte passed directly.

Did the original owner leave him any devil fruit? Where did he get the devil fruit?

Three-color domineering.

Armed and domineering, his ten-year-old physique is not enough.

Knowledgeable and domineering enough to practice.

Domineering domineering.

Only one in a million has the domineering look, and I don't know if I have this qualification.

After these three systems are eliminated, only swordsmanship and physical arts remain.

Charlotte still knows a little about these things.

You can try.

After having a goal, Charlotte arranged for herself.

His first goal is to train gymnastics.

And his reference object is Sauron. The anime clearly records how Sauron trains.

For example, lower body explosive training, lifting dumbbells and jumping.

Upper body explosive training, waving dumbbells with both hands.

and many more……!

Coupled with the training method I used in mercenaries to train physical skills and physique, this is very operable.

As for swordsmanship, Charlotte has no clue, but he only needs to be able to swing a sword.

He didn't believe that if he kept swinging the knife, he wouldn't be able to practice anything.

With Sauron's reference, it gave Charlotte a lot of determination.

He didn't believe that he was a time traveler.

With these thoughts.

Charlotte lay in her thatched cottage for two days, and started training after recovering from her injuries.

Charlotte himself didn't expect his injury to heal so quickly, and he could get out of bed alive and kicking in just two days.

You must know that when I was rescued from the beach, several bones in my body were broken.

After eating a few meals of meat, he miraculously recovered within two days.

And other people are not surprised when they see it.

It seems that all this is very normal.

And he also understood what kind of meat he was eating.

It is the king of the sea who bit off the red-haired left arm at the beginning of One Piece.

It belongs to the sea king class.

This made Charlotte think of another way to become stronger, which is to eat.
